title: 320. Two Sum III - Data Structure Design

examples.explanation: After storing 1, 3, 5: 4 equals 1 + 3 (true), while no pair sums to 7 (false).
The two stored zeros sum to 0.
A single stored 5 cannot pair with itself; 10 also has no pair yet.

hints: Keep counts of each added number so duplicates are handled: finding 2*x requires two copies of x.
For find(value), check whether value - x was seen for some stored x.
Construction and add report "null"; each find reports "true" or "false".
